name: clarify_tool_normalize_questions
notes: Batch-question normalization ladder (traced copy of src/tools/clarify_tool.c::clarify_normalize_questions vs LIVE tools/clarify_tool.py::_normalize_questions). Covers type errors, empty/oversized arrays, bare-string tolerance, blank-text errors, choice flattening/dedup-to-none, MAX_CHOICES clamp, id passthrough, multi_select gating. KNOWN divergences avoided by input choice: (1) a blank bare-string item errors in LIVE but is accepted verbatim by the C port (string fast-path skips the blank check); (2) dict/list choice elements exercise _flatten_choice coercion paths not mirrored here.
